title: Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder 15-Inch Solid Brass | Retro Wave Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your kitchen organization with a wall mount paper towel holder crafted from solid brass to help keep counters clean and essentials close at hand.

  • Coordinated look: part of the Retro Wave collection for a matching Retro Wave setup across your space
  • Refined installation: concealed screw mounting hardware keeps the look clean and traditional
  • Solid build: crafted from brass for a substantial feel
  • Finish flexibility: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement options such as autumn sparkle, fire engine red, unlacquered brass, golden yellow, and glokzin teal
  • What’s included: paper towel holder and all installation hardware

Specifications

  • Collection: Retro Wave (Traditional/Classic)
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Dimensions: 15-Inch H x 2.25-Inch W x 4-Inch L
  • Projection: 5-Inch
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 2.4 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
